chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
The most helpless of all men is he who cannot find a few brothers during his life, but still more helpless is he who finds such a brother but loses him.
ai.seo_question: What is the most helpless state of a person according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In this maxim from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) elevates the preservation of established spiritual and social bonds above their initial acquisition, reflecting the Shia emphasis on *mu'akhah* (brotherhood) as a dynamic covenant requiring active maintenance. This teaching underscores that true wisdom lies not in the quantity of companions but in the fidelity to those already secured, a principle deeply rooted in the Prophetic tradition of nurturing the community (*Ummah*).
